commit_message: Add Native 2D Tile Map scene runtime component
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Adds additive engine.tile_map_2d authoring/runtime composition with stable TileMap/TileSet/TileId/SpriteRef resolution, conversion-time validation, shared immutable decoded sprite sources, and one ECS owner per sparse chunked map.
